g.text: ACCURATE
exact values,
quoted words
COMPLETE
assess + act +
evaluate
TIMELY
real-time or
late-entry label!
YOUR LOGIN
never share,
log out!
4 NON-NEGOTIABLES: exact values + full nursing process + real-time timing + your own
login. "Vitals stable" is NOT charting — "BP 118/74, P 88 reg, R 18, T 36.8, SpO2 97% RA" is.
STRUCTURED vs NARRATIVE: tick-boxes/vitals flow for trends + searchable data; narrative for
story ("patient states 'the pain moved to my shoulder'"). Use BOTH: flow-sheet without story
loses meaning; story without numbers loses trends.
COPY-PASTE DANGERS (exam favourite!): cloned notes carry dead facts ("afebrile" on a febrile
child!), propagate errors, defraud billing, mislead the next nurse. Rules: NEVER copy vitals/
assessments forward; verify EVERY carried line; attest only what YOU did; facilities should
audit cloning — and examiners fail cloners.
AMENDMENTS: never delete/overwrite — addendum with date-time-reason ("late entry 14:20:
omitted 10:00 insulin — given, site L abdomen, BGL 11.2 → recheck 12:00"). Wrong-patient entry?
Flag + retract per policy + notify + document correction. Audit trails record ALL.
ABBREVIATIONS: only approved lists! "U" (units — mistaken for 0!), trailing zeros (5.0 mg),
"QD" (daily?) kill — write "units", "5 mg", "daily". EHR drop-downs exist to PREVENT this:
pick the list, don't free-text the danger.
CHARTING BY EXCEPTION? Only with rock-solid baselines + policy backing. Default: chart the
full assessment — "if it wasn't documented, it wasn't done" still rules courts.
STUDENT RULE: chart under your own login, co-signed per policy; never borrow a staff login —
borrowed logins forge legal records + hide your learning + end placements.
MANTRA: "accurate, complete, timely, mine — every entry, every time."
LINK: PRO-I M2 honesty + accountability — the EHR remembers what paper forgave.
